title: Every etale covering is an fpqc covering
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that every etale covering is an fpqc covering (statement lines 2733-2736). The proof verifies the two defining properties separately: faithful flatness is immediate from flatness and the covering condition (proof lines 2742-2744), while the quasi-compactness requirement needs an argument, namely writing an affine open V of the target as a union of images of affine opens of the sources using openness of etale morphisms, and then invoking quasi-compactness of V to extract a finite refinement (proof lines 2745-2752). The content is the second verification, where openness of etale morphisms is the non-formal input. The claim is H2: two short verifications, one of them with a genuine refinement step.
